card.title: Cant Draw Diagonal Lines After Screen Replacement

source.title: Cant Draw Diagonal Lines After Screen Replacement

symptoms: Apple Pencil diagonal lines wavy after screen replacement

claims.statement: After a screen swap on these iPads, Apple Pencil cannot draw straight diagonal lines until the original screen's calibration data is copied to the new screen.
claims.evidence: Fix uses a JCID V1SE / V1S Pro programmer with the iPad screen read/write adapter.

claims.statement: The original screen must be read while installed and powered, then the data written to the new screen while it is lit.
claims.evidence: Read on original screen, power off, swap screen, power on, write.

procedure: Fit the JCID iPad screen adapter flex for the model between the board and display.
Connect the ORIGINAL screen, power on, select the iPad model on the programmer and press Read.
Power off, connect the new screen, power on and press Write.
Power off, remove the adapter and connect the new screen normally.
Test diagonal lines with Apple Pencil in Notes.
card.caveats: Requires the original screen to still light up so its data can be read. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
